caption:
The biggest IPO in history has a $26 billion side door.

Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, prices Wednesday and starts trading Thursday on the Nasdaq as ANT. Its filing shows a $26 billion private placement at the IPO price — with Google and Nvidia putting in about $10 billion each, plus AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC.

The companies that sell AI its chips are buying AI's stock.

My take: the AI economy is turning into a circle where everyone is each other's customer and shareholder. Circles are strong — until one link isn't.

Would you buy in on day one? 👇
